Records & field

Situation Reporting

Turn the current operational picture into a clear situation report. Reporting draws from command, operations, safety, weather, and resources to describe what changed and what comes next.

In this workspace

What the section handles.

SITREP workspace

Assemble current conditions, actions, issues, and anticipated needs.

Operational status

Use task and team progress to keep the report aligned with work in the field.

ICS-209 export

Carry situation data into the ICS-209 format.

Other report formats

Use the same incident information for other situation-report outputs.

In practice

From input to action.

The workspace shares its records with related areas of the incident, so an update can inform the next task or decision.

  1. CollectBring together the latest field and staff inputs.
  2. SynthesizeSummarize the situation and identify needs or decisions.
  3. DistributeProduce the report and retain it with the incident record.
